document.abstract: Using lower-resolution proxy files for video production has been an option for a number of years; however, advancements in technology, remote working demands, and a drive toward remote production and usage of cloud technologies have opened up a range of new possibilities. Modern proxy workflows depend on a set of underlying technologies to provide a seamless, secure, and productive user experience. The article will identify enablers for remote production and provide concrete examples to illustrate how media professionals: 1) overcome challenges of collaborating with high-resolution footage; 2) control access to valuable original footage; and 3) create unique renditions to simplify workflows and increase traceability.

authors.bio: Stephen Tallamy is an Emmy Award winning chief technology officer with significant experience in the media and entertainment industry. He has pioneered cloud and hybrid systems for both media delivery and production industries. He holds a range of patents in the areas of metadata management, intelligent video content generation, and video access control.
